pages.title: About
pages.description: Who we are, how we choose AI tools for contractors and trades, and what we will not do.
pages.body:
This site is an independent directory of AI tools for contractors and trade businesses. It exists because most "best AI tools" lists are written by people who have never run a job, and they group tools by category rather than by the job you are actually trying to get done.

How we choose tools

A tool is listed only if it does at least one job a trade business genuinely pays for: quoting, scheduling, invoicing, customer communication, site documentation, marketing or bookkeeping. We favour tools that are actually used in the trades over generic small business software with an AI badge.

What we say plainly

  • When a tool's value is traditional software rather than AI, we say so.
  • When a tool has a real free tier, we mark it.
  • We do not rank tools by affiliate commission.

What we are not

We are not a software vendor and we do not provide professional, legal or financial advice. Confirm pricing, features and suitability with the vendor before you commit to anything.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.description: How this site handles visitor data, cookies and advertising.
pages.body:
This page explains what data this site collects and how it is used.

Information we collect

We do not require registration and we do not collect personal information in order to use this site.

Cookies and advertising

We use Google AdSense to display advertising. Google and its partners may use cookies to serve ads based on your prior visits to this or other websites. You can opt out of personalised advertising by visiting Google's Ads Settings.

Analytics

We use privacy-focused analytics that do not set cookies and do not track individuals across sites.

Third-party links

Links to tool vendors go to sites we do not control. Their privacy practices are their own.

Contact

Questions about this policy can be sent to the address on our contact page.

pages.title: Terms of Use
pages.description: Terms and conditions for using this directory.
pages.body:
By using this site you agree to these terms.

Information is provided as-is

Tool descriptions, features and prices are compiled for general information. Vendors change pricing and features frequently. Always verify details on the vendor's own site before making a purchase decision.

No professional advice

Nothing here constitutes legal, financial or professional advice.

Links to third parties

We link to external sites for convenience. We do not control them and are not responsible for their content or practices.

Changes

We may update these terms at any time.

pages.title: Contact

pages.body:
